## AI

### Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 AI model
🔥🔥🔥🔥◯ Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, a model priced at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens (unchanged from predecessor Opus 4.8), pitched as delivering performance close to flagship Claude Fable 5 at half the API cost. It scored 43.3% on Frontier Bench v0.1 versus Fable 5's 33.7% on internal benchmarks, becomes the new default model on Claude Max and the strongest option on Claude Pro, and features improved coding/agent capabilities, less restrictive cybersecurity safeguards, no 30-day data retention requirement, and is described by Anthropic as its most aligned model to date.
